summary: Subset Games' compact turn-based mech tactics roguelite, expanded by the free Advanced Edition update and later Netflix mobile versions.

entries.title: Into the Breach
entries.definitive_edition: Into the Breach: Advanced Edition on PC

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for PC; mobile versions are subscription-gated through Netflix.

primary.version: Into the Breach: Advanced Edition on PC
primary.why: Windows has the complete Advanced Edition content, flexible capture, and native PC controls; Switch and mobile are excellent portable routes but not higher fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version with the free Advanced Edition update installed for the expanded squads, pilots, enemies, missions, weapons, and Unfair difficulty.
